record.original_question: Can one obtain rigorous explicit formulas for Tracy-Widom distribution functions for general beta-ensembles beyond the classical invariant cases beta = 1, 2, and 4, including a rigorous completion of Rumanov's approach for all even beta > 0 and a rigorous verification of the asymptotic formulas proposed by Borot, Eynard, Majumdar, and Nadal for general beta > 0?

evidence.quote: An open problem of long-standing interest concerns explicit formulae for the Tracy-Widom distribution functions for general beta-ensembles. It is of great interest to complete Rumanov's analysis rigorously, not only for beta = 6, but for all even beta > 0. It is a challenging open problem to verify rigorously these formulae of Borot et al.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each $\beta>0$, the $\beta$-ensemble at the soft edge gives rise to a Tracy–Widom-type limiting distribution $F_\beta$, which for the classical values $\beta\in\{1,2,4\}$ admits explicit Painlevé II representations due to Tracy and Widom. The task is twofold:

(a) (Rigorous completion of Rumanov's approach.) Rumanov proposed Lax-pair representations and explicit formulas for $F_\beta$ for even integer $\beta$, expressing $F_\beta$ in terms of the Hastings–McLeod solution of Painlevé II together with an auxiliary function satisfying a coupled ODE. Rigorously establish such explicit Painlevé/Calogero–Painlevé representations of $F_\beta$ for every even integer $\beta>0$, including a rigorous justification of the corresponding Riemann–Hilbert / isomonodromy framework and of the asymptotic analysis at $\pm\infty$.

(b) (Rigorous verification of the Borot–Eynard–Majumdar–Nadal predictions.) For general $\beta>0$, Borot, Eynard, Majumdar, and Nadal proposed asymptotic formulas for the left and right tails of $F_\beta$ as the argument tends to $-\infty$ and $+\infty$, with explicit leading exponents and constants depending on $\beta$. Rigorously prove these tail asymptotics for all $\beta>0$.

Provide a rigorous derivation of explicit formulas (in (a)) and a rigorous proof of the asymptotic formulas (in (b)) for the Tracy–Widom $\beta$-distributions beyond the classical cases $\beta=1,2,4$.
artifact.status_search_result: Rumanov's approach has been substantially developed for the case $\beta=6$: Rumanov (2015) gave a Painlevé representation, and subsequent work by Grava–Its–Kapaev–Mezzadri (2016) and by Bertola–Cafasso–Rubtsov, together with later papers (e.g. arXiv:2010.06733, arXiv:1812.00522), connected $F_6$ to the second Calogero–Painlevé system and provided a Riemann–Hilbert framework enabling rigorous asymptotic analysis. However, a rigorous completion of Rumanov's analysis for all even $\beta>0$ and a rigorous proof of the Borot–Eynard–Majumdar–Nadal tail asymptotics for general $\beta>0$ do not appear to have been fully achieved, so the problem remains partially solved.

status_evidence.title: On the Tracy-Widom_β Distribution for β=6
status_evidence.snippet: Painlevé / Riemann–Hilbert analysis of Tracy–Widom distribution at β=6, building on Rumanov's Lax pair.
status_evidence.claim: The β=6 case has been rigorously analyzed via a Riemann–Hilbert approach extending Rumanov.

status_evidence.title: On β=6 Tracy-Widom distribution and the second Calogero-Painlevé system
status_evidence.snippet: Connection of TW_6 with the second Calogero–Painlevé system, allowing Deift–Zhou steepest descent analysis.
status_evidence.claim: Calogero–Painlevé framework provides rigorous tools for β=6, but extension to all even β remains incomplete.

status_evidence.title: On the Open Question of The Tracy-Widom Distribution of β-Ensemble With β=6
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses open questions concerning TW distribution at β=6.
status_evidence.claim: Open questions about TW_β explicit formulas persist beyond β=6.
